information_flow: The first call receives all common inputs and emits a nonbinding analysis that exposes inherited assumptions without creating or authorizing a policy artifact. The final call consumes that analysis, receives every common input directly, independently reconciles the public evidence, and emits the lineage's only policy.
name: Re-entrant Evidence Fan-In with Sole Authorship
organization: two-call sequential lineage with one non-policy counter-analysis edge and direct full-evidence fan-in to the only policy author

calls.objective: Identify conflicts created by inherited structural assumptions across the supplied public evidence, while withholding policy authorship and preserving each common input as independently visible evidence.

Consume negate_inherited_structure as nonbinding counterevidence, independently reconcile every directly supplied common input, and emit exactly one complete policy conforming to the public contract and constraints.
